## Plotting with Kara Jones

## 1. Before plotting:

- WHat is the story you aer trying to tell. 
- What is the best visual to tell that story.  
- What can I remove that distracts from the story.  

## 2. When possible:
- Label directly.  
- Annotate groups.  
- Check contrast.  
- improve readability.  
- Use comparisons that are intuitive (same scale).  
- Don't use missleading axes.  
- Order data to guide viewer.  
- Dont add extraneous decoration.  
- Accesibility.  - package dichromat to check how it looks for color-blindness.
